name: Kardan Bugbear

source.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance

text: You have dark gray fur that helps you move about stealthily. Whenever you gain the hidden condition, such as by succeeding at a skill check to create-a-diversion or hide, you can Step as a free action. At the GM's discretion, this movement might cause you to become observed (for instance, if you moved into an area of bright light or to a space that doesn't provide cover).
